segmentName: Nicotine Derivative APIs (pharmaceutical-grade, for NRT/vape formulators)

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates diverge sharply by scope — a genuine methodology problem, not just a range: Grand View Research $69.17B (2023) to $198.71B by 2030 (16.3%/yr); Coherent Market Insights $53.47B (2023) to $105.34B by 2030 (10.2%/yr); Bonafide Research $80.01B (2024) to $186.18B by 2030 (15.44%/yr); a narrower definition elsewhere pegs it at only $6.9B by 2033 (7.99%/yr). The order-of-magnitude spread ($6.9B vs $198.7B) indicates these reports define 'NRT market' very differently (devices/finished products vs. broader nicotine-product categories including e-cigarettes/heat-not-burn) — treat as directional only.
